question: I'm a CS 5th-year student. I've completed 15-112, 15-122, 15-150, 15-213, 15-251, 15-210, and 15-451. Have I satisfied all the required CS core milestones as defined in the CS progress policy?
expected_answer: Yes — the CS satisfactory progress policy requires: First-Year Spring: 21-127, 15-112 (done); Sophomore Spring: 15-122 (done); Junior Fall: 15-150, 15-213 (done); Junior Spring: 15-210, 15-251 (done). P-009 has completed all milestone courses. However, additional graduation requirements (electives, humanities, etc.) may remain.
common_mistake: Conflating the milestone policy with full graduation requirements; missing that milestone completion ≠ graduation readiness
needs_verification: Confirm P-009's grades in all listed milestone courses meet passing standards
Confirm the full graduation requirement list for CS (additional electives, humanities, etc.)
Confirm P-009 has completed 21-127 (shown in Fall 2022) per milestone policy
